capabilities: create one-time and recurring events via dialog, commands or the Calendar plugin
show events grouped by day in a searchable, filterable timeline sidebar
display read-only ICS calendars from Google Calendar or iCloud
generate dated notes per event occurrence with frontmatter properties
show a pending-count badge in the status bar and on the ribbon icon
extras: Works on mobile with an adapted layout; event note property names can be English or Spanish; events can be exported and imported as JSON.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create, repeat and view dated events alongside notes; Calendar shows dates but holds no events.

relations.evidence: With the Calendar plugin installed, Memento adds to its month view
Google Calendar: in the calendar's settings, under Integrate calendar, copy the secret address in iCal format.
iCloud: share the calendar as a public calendar and copy its link.

summary: Event manager that stores one-time and recurring events in the vault and shows them in a sidebar timeline, with read-only ICS calendars and event notes.
